title: Zeno v3.5.1
body:
## Zeno v3.5.1

Notetaker control and reliability update.

### Highlights
- Auto-Watch saves immediately and stays off when disabled
- Notetaker worker fully stops when Auto-Watch is off
- Analyze Once no longer changes Auto-Watch state
- Universal STOP control is visible in the chat composer
- End Session control
- Timeline search and event filters
- Compact live activity list
- Safe session_id database migration ordering

Complete updater-safe modular release package. Private runtime data is excluded.
